# Get all contacts from the phone app to check against message senders.
contacts = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    contacts.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total contacts: {len(contacts)}")
print(contacts)
